item.text:
**Bottom line:** Mixed, leaning negative. Jokowi did sometimes pair public statements with concrete action and allowed a formal handover, but the 2024 record also shows strong signs of strategic misrepresentation around election neutrality, succession, and the information environment. Direct, smoking-gun evidence of lies to the legislature or courts is limited, so the judgment rests mostly on indirect but still strong evidence.

**Accepted Claims**
- [President Jokowi calls on president, VP-elect to work immediately after inauguration](https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-calls-on-president-vp-elect-to-work-immediately-after-inauguration/) - Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-04-24. Jokowi said the Constitutional Court process was almost complete, that the decision must be respected as final and binding, and that the cabinet would only help a smooth transition. This is solid positive evidence that he publicly accepted institutional outcomes rather than lying to block succession. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`.

- [Farewell, Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President, from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/) - Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-10-20. The official handover record shows Jokowi formally transferring power to Prabowo on inauguration day. That supports truthful public adherence to the constitutional transition, even if other parts of the year were less clean. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`.

- [Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholds Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-prabowos-win/2051948/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-04-22. The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling. This is the best formal-positive evidence that the election outcome was not hidden behind a fabricated account from the state side, though it does not erase the surrounding neutrality concerns. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`.

- [Indonesia president orders audit of data centres after cyberattack](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) - Reuters via South China Morning Post, 2024-06-28. After a major cyberattack, Jokowi ordered an audit rather than denying the failure. This is positive evidence of public correction and partial candor when disclosure could have damaged reputation. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `6B.6`, `6B.9`.

- [President urges BPKP to audit national data center governance](https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance) - ANTARA News, 2024-06-28. The government publicly acknowledged the cyber failure and moved to audit governance. That reinforces the point that Jokowi sometimes chose correction over concealment. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `6B.6`, `6B.9`.

- [President Jokowi asks for mitigation on NPWP data breach](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4345027/presiden-jokowi-minta-perlunya-mitigasi-soal-kebocoran-data-npwp) - ANTARA News, 2024-09-19. Jokowi ordered Kominfo, Finance, and BSSN to mitigate the alleged taxpayer-data breach quickly. This is another partial positive signal: he responded to a public failure with mitigation rather than denial alone. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `6B.6`, `6B.9`.

- [Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/) - Reuters, 2024-02-01. Reuters reported mounting criticism of Jokowi’s apparent non-neutrality, including visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket. This is strong negative evidence for truthful neutrality in a matter where misdirection protected power and family advantage. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`.

- [Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-19. Reuters reported Jokowi appointing people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles while framing the reshuffle as transition-smoothing. This is not a direct lie claim, but it is strong evidence of politically strategic presentation and patronage over candor. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`.

- [Poll shows Jokowi’s approval rating falling after protests but still popular](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/10/05/poll-shows-jokowis-approval-rating-falls-after-protests-but-still-popular) - Reuters via The Jakarta Post, 2024-10-05. Allies’ election-rule push would have helped Jokowi’s youngest son and triggered backlash. That supports a negative reading: the public-facing story was not cleanly aligned with the family-advantage politics underneath it. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`.

- [Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Freedom House says disinformation spread widely before the February election, political buzzers manipulated public opinion, and government-linked actors helped distort the information environment. This is strong negative evidence that Jokowi operated in, and did not fully restrain, a truth-poor political ecosystem. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.6`, `4B.2`, `6B.9`.

- [Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon, leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. As background, that is the strongest broad negative signal that truthfulness and clean public explanation were not his habitual style when power or reputation were at stake. QIDs: `7B.1`; also `4B.2`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`.

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong direct evidence of Jokowi lying to the legislature or courts in 2024.
- The best evidence is instead indirect: election neutrality problems, family-advantaging rule changes, disinformation, and selective transparency on failures.
- So the most defensible reading is not “proven habitual lying,” but “frequent strategic opacity with some real instances of candor and institutional compliance.”
